morning_soundtrack.title: St. Vincent Covers Yeah Yeah Yeahs At Gabriela Hearst’s Spring 2027 Runway Show
morning_soundtrack.snippet: St. Vincent was at Paris Fashion Week on Monday to provide a live soundtrack for Gabriela Hearst's spring 2027 collection, which was inspired by Afghan women’s textile traditions. Annie Clark's stripped down four-song set in the courtyard of the Petit Palais included three of her own tunes — it was bracketed by MASSEDUCTION singles "New York" and "Los Ageless" and featured "Violent Times" from 2024's All Born Screaming — but most notably, she covered the Yeah Yeah Yeahs.

morning_soundtrack.title: Anna Meredith Announces New Album Darling: Hear “Dusky”
morning_soundtrack.snippet: It's been years since we've checked in with Scottish composer and electronic musician Anna Meredith. In recent years she's released all kinds of projects including the bumper car sound installation Bumps Per Minute: 18 Studies For Dodgems , a collaboration with the string quartet Ligeti Quartet called Nuc , and soundtracks for the movies The End We Start From and Thursday . More recently, she scored Wicker , a Sundance fantasy comedy starring Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård, set for release Oct.
